purpose: Tracks cloud-credit spend for cloud sessions started from this repo. The user set a cap; every cloud run is priced per model from its own transcripts with scripts/claude-cost-report.mjs.
stopRule: Do not start a phase whose estimate exceeds (cap - spent). Stop and report at 90% of the cap.
rates: USD per million tokens, see RATES in scripts/claude-cost-report.mjs (Fable 5.1 10/50, Opus 5.5 4/20, Sonnet 5.5 2/10, Haiku 4.5 1/5; cache read 0.25/0.20/0.20/0.10; cache write 1.25x input for 5-minute TTL, 2x for 1-hour)

phases.ranIn: LOCAL worktree on the user machine, NOT in the cloud
phases.why: The Agent tool isolation:"remote" is gated for this session and silently fell back to a local worktree. The cost report read this machine's transcripts.
phases.localUsageNote: Counted against the Claude subscription window, not the credits. 7-day window was 94% before and 98% after.
phases.verified: orchestrator rerun: lint 0 errors, 2604 unit tests, 33 e2e, harness 7 passed 1 skipped (redirect, unit-covered)

notes: Local usage on this machine is a Claude subscription window, not these credits. Do not count it here.
Costs are list-price estimates from transcripts, not an invoice. Check the console for the real balance.
howToRunInCloud: Start a Claude Code web session at claude.ai/code on github.com/nvitthanala/omniswim-suite (branch nvitthanala/ui-simplification) and paste docs/reference/cloud-handoff/C2_BRIEF.md. After each phase run: node scripts/claude-cost-report.mjs --since <start> and add the output here.
